rotation.note: Operator override: the FULL gadgets keyword set is used as seeds (core + every keyword in keyword_pool.sections.gadgets.keywords = 3 + 30 = 33), not a date-rotated slice. Date rotation (day-of-month 19) is applied to EMPHASIS ORDER only. 2026-09-18 led with the wearables/XR/on-device-silicon face; 19 mod 30 = 19 -> today leads with the AMBIENT HOME face (smart home, robots, appliances, TV, speakers, companion/toy devices), moves to silicon/PC in the middle, and TRAILS with glasses/wearables — which are also the most-covered slice in the last 2 days, so they get one forward-looking query (Meta Connect, Sept 23-24) instead of the lead block.

retrieval_hint.why: Plain `site:` WebSearch returns stale evergreen hub pages for these outlets and the published_time gate then kills most of them. Harvest each domain's RSS/Atom/news-sitemap first, keep items whose pubDate is inside the 336h (14-day) window, and only then use the WebSearch queries below to fill gaps.
